title: Fix the Inconsistent Record Processor
description: The program should print the email of every user record, skipping any record that doesn't have one. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print Asha's and Meera's emails, and skip Ravi's record since it has no email field.
actualProblem: Ravi's dictionary has no 'email' key at all, so user["email"] raises a KeyError and crashes the loop partway through, instead of gracefully skipping that record.
explanation: When processing a batch of dictionaries that may not all share the same keys, use dict.get(key) (which returns None for a missing key instead of raising) rather than square-bracket access, then check the result before using it.
